company.shortDescription: Kernel is a neuroscience company that specializes in developing brain-recording technologies.
company.description:
Kernel is a neuroscience company that specializes in developing brain-recording technologies. Its custom-built, non-invasive brain interface acquires neural signals similar in quality to fMRI, MEG & ECoG, as easy to use as EEG.

It was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, California.
